title: Closures and Lexical Scope: Environment Capture at Definition Time
description: Shows Environment class (linked frames), Closure class (params, body, captured env), and eval_call (creates child env parented on closure's env - the key to lexical scope). Trace: make_adder(5) creates closure capturing global, call creates local env with n=5, returns inner closure capturing that local. add5(3) looks up x in call env, n in parent (local where n=5). Demo verifies closure captured env with make_adder bound.

steps.description: Environment: _vars dict, parent link. define adds to current frame. lookup searches current then parent chain. assign updates existing or recurses to parent.
Closure: params list, body AST, env (captured at definition). ReturnSignal exception for early return from nested blocks.
execute_fundef: creates Closure with CURRENT env, binds to name in that env. Closure captures defining environment.
eval_call: checks Closure type, arity. Line 48: local = Environment(parent=fn.env) - PARENTS ON DEFINING ENV, not calling env. Binds params, evaluates body in local, catches ReturnSignal.
THE ONE LINE THAT CHOOSES LEXICAL SCOPE: parent=fn.env. If changed to parent=env (caller's env), language becomes dynamically scoped.

steps.question: In Step 3 (add5(3)), why does lookup('n') find 5 instead of failing or finding a different value?
steps.answer: add5 is inner_closure from Step 2, whose env=local (where n=5). eval_call creates call_env with parent=fn.env (that local). lookup('n') checks call_env (only has x=3), then parent (local) finds n=5. Lexical scope: n bound where add5 was defined, not where called.

steps.description: Detailed trace comments: Step 1 definition captures global_env. Step 2 call make_adder(5) creates local with n=5, returns inner closure capturing local. Step 3 call add5(3) uses that local as parent, n=5 found there.
Demo: global_env = Environment(). execute_fundef creates make_adder closure. Verifies it's a Closure and its captured env has 'make_adder' bound.
Output: make_adder is a Closure: True; make_adder captured env has 'make_adder': True
